dedupe_keys.name: godeeep transportation electrification load profiles by balancing authority and state level electrification rates in the western us pnnl

description: PNNL researchers built these datasets for the GODEEEP project to show how transport electrification adds load to the Western Electricity Coordinating Council (WECC) interconnection. Version 2.0.0 of August 2024 gives hourly charging load profiles for the transportation sector for each balancing authority, plus annual fleet sizes by state and vehicle type, transport energy use by state and fuel, and fuel use by state, for net-zero pathways without and with carbon capture and with Inflation Reduction Act policies, combined with RCP 4.5 cooler and RCP 8.5 hotter climate pathways. Earlier versions 1.0.0 and 1.0.1 of 2023 gave balancing authority profiles to 2050 for business-as-usual and net-zero pathways; files are named by balancing authority, pathway, climate scenario and year, with light-duty vehicle charging energy in MWh among the columns, and climate only affects light-duty vehicles. Data are available for free download under CC0 from Zenodo with code on GitHub. Coverage is the Western United States. Caveats: profiles come from scenario models, not metered charging. Simulation uses are future hourly EV load by balancing authority for resource adequacy and transmission planning under climate scenarios. Related records: data-gcam-usa-godeeep-scenarios gives the underlying pathways and data-godeeep-hourly-wind-solar-profiles-conus the matching renewable profiles.
